name: Gwenpool
description:
She knows she's in a card game, and uses it.
Gwen Poole read the comics, so she knows the rules better than the heroes do. Her speech bubbles are rules: resolve them to break the fourth wall, bend her own cards and get away with it. Too Much Pink catches up with her, and Evil Gwenpool is waiting. Includes a 'Pool starter deck. 22 cards. Spanish original, English translation. Pairs with NeXt Evolution.
